daily.title: Oscars 2027 : le film « Minotaure » va être proposé par la France pour concourir dans la catégorie meilleur film international
daily.summary: La candidature française doit être envoyée à l’Académie des Oscars, qui annoncera le 21 janvier 2027 quels sont les nommés dans cette catégorie.

daily.summary: Des pirates ont usurpé l’identité d’une agence gouvernementale pour obtenir des données sensibles de clients. Une enquête a été ouverte en Italie et le régulateur britannique de la protection des données examine des informations après un « signalement ».

Also, about 20,000 Ethiopian university students in the northern region of Tigray will be relocated to other campuses across the country. And in northern Senegal, scientists are using fish to keep their food stoicks and communtites healthy.

daily.title: Hashim Thaçi, l’ex-président du Kosovo, héros de l’indépendance chez beaucoup dans son pays, condamné à vingt-cinq ans de prison par un tribunal international

daily.summary: Russian President Vladimir ⁠Putin on Wednesday described voter turnout in the upcoming parliamentary election as a barometer of public support for Russia’s war against Ukraine and urged voters to go to the polls. It will be Russia's first parliamentary election since the Kremlin launched its offensive in February 2022.

daily.title: La Fed va à l’encontre de Donald Trump et augmente ses taux directeurs pour lutter contre l’inflation aux Etats-Unis

daily.title: Qui sont les morts de la canicule ?  « Le Monde » raconte des vies derrière les chiffres
daily.summary: Selon les données publiées mercredi par Santé publique France, 8 124 personnes sont mortes à cause de la chaleur pendant les canicules entre fin mai et fin août. Personnes âgées, travailleurs... « Le Monde » raconte en onze portraits ces femmes et ces hommes victimes du réchauffement climatique en France.

daily.title: Russian drone strike on a passenger bus in Ukraine kills 5 people and wounds at least 7 others
daily.summary: A Russian drone struck a passenger bus in southern Ukraine early Wednesday, killing five people and wounding at least seven. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy described the attack, the latest in a series of Russian strikes on civilian transportation, as an “atrocity.” France 24's Gulliver Cragg tells us more.

daily.title: Trump administration plans to send powerful bombs to Israel in $2.8 billion weapons sale
daily.summary: The Trump administration is planning to deliver powerful 2,000-pound bombs to Israel as part of an upcoming arms deal, weapons that prompted such concerns about the possibility of mass casualties in Gaza that the Biden administration paused their delivery two years ago. France 24's Philip Turle tells us more.

daily.title: EU: An unprecedented offer to Canada
daily.summary:
European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen on Wednesday proposed making Canada the European Union's first associate member, a striking overture as U.S. President Donald Trump's threats drive Ottawa closer to Europe.

Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney spoke of a "unique alliance with the EU".

daily.title: Kenya: First World Athletics Championships to be held in Africa
daily.summary:
For the first time, the World Athletics Championships will be held on the African continent, with Kenya set to host the event in 2029.

World Athletics President Sebastian Coe described Kenya's bid as "convincing and moving".

Our Nairobi correspondent Bastien Renouil has the details.

daily.title: DR Congo: Protests against plan to change the constitution
daily.summary:
In DR Congo, the C64 opposition coalition took to the streets of Kinshasa as the country's parliament returned for a new session. Its members have been opposing a proposed constitutional change backed by the ruling majority for several months.

Report by Aurélie Bazzara-Kibangula.

daily.summary: The World Health Organization said Wednesday that the fight against the Ebola outbreak in DR Congo was showing “encouraging signs" but that the epidemic was "far from over". More than 7,000 cases have been reported across seven provinces as of September 11.
